create_MapInfra_cached_method: create a MapInfra instance with folder and mode to cache pydantic model method results on disk
apply_MapInfra_decorator: apply the MapInfra apply decorator with item_uid to a method that yields one output per input item
split_list_to_chunks: use to_chunks to split a list of items into smaller chunks with max_chunks and min_items_per_chunk
configure_MapInfra_cluster_execution: configure MapInfra cluster to threadpool or processpool for local parallel execution of cached methods
create_MapInfraMethod_validator: create a MapInfraMethod dataclass that validates the decorated method signature takes self and one sequence argument
